_comment: Architecture registry: the source of truth of the MAVILERA landing page (tools/release.mjs builds the cards from it; tools/release.mjs refuses a registry that links a module whose build is missing). Copyright (c) 2026 Sajid Muhaimin Choudhury. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. Add a module by appending an entry; see docs/ADDING-SIMULATORS.md. `content`: the content folders of a module built from src/arch/<id> (tools/site-files.mjs archFiles).

architectures.name: RISC-V
architectures.description: RV32I with the M extension: assembler, C-subset compiler, and single-cycle, multicycle and five-stage pipelined processors animated on their datapaths. With the NPU tool: a 4 × 4 systolic-array accelerator on the bus, shown from the system down to one processing element.
architectures.tagline: RV32I with M: an assembler, a C subset, and single-cycle, multicycle and pipelined processors on their datapaths.

architectures.name: SAP-1
architectures.description: The simple-as-possible computer: five instructions, sixteen bytes of memory, an accumulator and an adder-subtracter on one bus, each instruction stepped through its six timing states on a drawing of the bus and its controller.
architectures.tagline: The simple-as-possible computer: five instructions on one bus, each stepped through six timing states.

architectures.name: SAP-2
architectures.description: The simple-as-possible computer, version 2: 43 instructions, 64K bytes of memory, a flag pair, CALL and RET, and input and output ports with a keys-and-serial panel; each instruction stepped through its timing states on a drawing of the bus and its controller.
architectures.tagline: Forty-three instructions, input and output ports, CALL and RET, stepped state by state.

architectures.name: Armv7
architectures.description: The 32-bit ARM instruction set of Harris and Harris's ARM edition: assembler and instruction-level simulator, and the textbook's single-cycle, multicycle and pipelined processors animated on their datapaths, each with an Extended datapath for the Chapter 7 exercise extensions.
architectures.tagline: The 32-bit ARM instruction set on single-cycle, multicycle and pipelined processors, with an Extended datapath.

architectures.name: GPU
architectures.description: A SIMT core: four or eight lanes run one stream of a seven-instruction micro-ISA, with an active mask and a two-deep mask stack for divergent branches; assembler and instruction-level simulator with the lanes' registers. A preview: the core's views come in later releases.
architectures.tagline: A SIMT core: lanes, an active mask and divergent branches, instruction by instruction.

_landing: The order of the landing page's cards, three to a row (author, 2026-11-05): every module and tool once.
_tools: Tools inside a module (src/shell/platform-archs.js): a card after their module's, linking into it; not built on their own.

tools.name: NPU
tools.description: A 4 × 4 weight-stationary systolic array of INT8 processing elements on the RISC-V processor's bus: the subsystem, the systolic array, one processing element and the system, with each cycle's transfers animated, an RTL-checked cycle model, and an analysis of offload, roofline and Amdahl's law.
tools.tagline: A 4 × 4 systolic array on the RISC-V processor's bus, driven by your program, cycle by cycle.

_learn: The landing page's learning paths by topic (author, 2026-11-05): each step opens a laboratory or tool (`lab`, an id of `architectures` or `tools`) and names the view to choose there (`view`, as the application labels it). tools/release.mjs refuses a step whose laboratory is not available.

learn.title: How a computer works
learn.summary: A bus, a few registers and a controller, one clock state at a time.

steps.text: Five instructions stepped through their fetch and execute states, with the control word of every state.
More instructions, input and output ports, and subroutines with CALL and RET.

learn.title: Instruction sets
learn.summary: Write assembly, step it forwards and backwards, and watch the registers and memory change.

steps.text: RV32I with the M extension: the encoding of every instruction, and a C subset compiled to assembly.
Conditional execution, the flags N, Z, C and V, and R15 as the program counter.

learn.title: Datapaths and pipelining
learn.summary: One program on three processors, animated signal by signal.

steps.text: Every instruction in one clock cycle on the datapath drawing.
The controller's state diagram and the cycles each instruction takes.
Five stages with forwarding, stalls, flushes and branch prediction.
One program run on the three processors and compared.
The same ideas on the ARM pipeline: the hazard unit's forwarding, stalls and flushes.

learn.title: Parallel hardware
learn.summary: Many processing elements, or many lanes, working on one task.

steps.text: A systolic array driven by a RISC-V program: where the cycles go when the work is offloaded.
Lanes running one instruction stream: the active mask and divergent branches. A preview.
